== Description ==
#HAYDAY - Life on the farm is hard work.  Farmers work from dawn, some before and go until it is too dark out to work.  Playing this game, I relate back to those days of being poor, the sweat and toil of planting and harvesting crops.    Raising cows to provide milk, butter and other dairy products and even beef for the daily dinner.  So many things that the farmers and their wives did to provide for their children are just fading memories of the past.  A farm had to supply the families every need.  Real farm tasks are a lost art.  Come, join in and sometimes I will take a trip down memory lane.
